messages:
ana: found partner logs in gs://ingest-logs/old-partner/ that contain KMS ciphertext fragments and partner SA emails. unsure if any decryption happened.

lee: which key?

ana: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-keys/cryptoKeys/ingest-key. partner SA: partner-integ@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

trent: immediate actions: revoke grant, snapshot objects to sec-archive, rewrap to our new key, search logs for decrypts, update vault secrets if needed.

ana: created incident sec-1777770000 and started snapshot to gs://sec-archive/1777770000/immutable/.

ops-bot: AUDIT: revoked IAM binding for partner-integ@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com on ingest-key (cmd exit 0).

lee: checking audit sink -- i see storage.write was removed from sink-collector SA during last week's RBAC cleanup. regranted and kicked backlog.

trent: SIEM backfill shows two Decrypt calls by partner SA in 2024-06. escalate to P1.

ana: performing rewrap to projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/secure-rotations/cryptoKeys/ingest-key-v2 on an ephemeral VM.

lee: adding org policy to block cross-project grants to partner-keys key ring for the duration.

trent: will update Vault entries that referenced old ciphertext to point to rewrapped blobs and create new secret versions. legal wants 7y retention tag on the archive.

ana: draft partner notification prepared, includes timeline and mitigation steps.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: revoke done, archive created, rewrap in progress, SIEM confirms decrypts => severity P1, owners: @trent @lee, legal looped.

trent: i'll own final rotation and post completion. ping @ana @lee when done. :white_check_mark:
